verdict.rationale: cubic publishes a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its Analytics API at /openapi/analytics.json. The Members API's full OpenAPI 3.1.0 operations are embedded per endpoint in markdown mirrors. The probe's 404s were only on conventional discovery paths, so they do not contradict the published spec location. missing for 10: a single downloadable spec covering the whole API (the Members API has no standalone file), discoverability at standard OpenAPI paths, independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec downloads and works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
